items.t: Voted for a January 17 House resolution denouncing President Biden's border policies, as one of 14 Democrats who crossed the aisle to support it.
items.q: Fourteen Democrats, including border-state Reps. Colin Allred, Vicente Gonzalez, Henry Cuellar of Texas and Reps. Mary Peltola, D-Alaska, Greg Landsman, D-Ohio, and Yadira Caraveo, D-Colo., crossed the aisle on the measure.

items.t: Voted for the Assault Weapons Ban of 2022.
items.q: Allred supported the Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order of 2021, a red flag gun law, and voted for the failed Assault Weapons Ban of 2022.

bio: Colin Allred was born and raised in Dallas by a single mom who was a public school teacher, and thanks to those same public schools, his coaches, teachers and the folks at the YMCA, Allred succeeded as a standout student-athlete.
